Repository: Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York, NY
Artist Display Bio: Italian, Borgo Sansepolcro ca. 1582–1656 Florence|French, active 1660–1691
Portfolio: The magnificent pageant on the river Arno in Florence for the marriage of the Grand Duke (Le Magnifique carousel fait sur le fleuve de l'Arne a Florence, pour le mariage du Grand Duc), for the wedding celebration of Cosimo de' Medici in Florence, 1608
